events.title: Patch 0.5.8
events.summary: With this patch the demo build of the game is public!ChangesFixed initial frame on game boot being blue.Fixed player movement with joystick sometimes getting stuck moving forward.Player invulnerability after getting hit is now a constant 0.2 seconds instead of scaling 0.1 + 0.01* Vitality

events.title: Patch 0.5.5
events.summary: ChangesAdded a final leaderboard score UI when the game is over.Added a difficulty option that changes the amount of health and damage for enemiesFixed weapon "Light Sabre" collision being activate at the start of a levelLowered base range and amount of projectiles for "Magic Burst" abilityFixed cold debuff not slowing enemies correctly

events.title: Patch 0.5.3
events.summary: ChangesAdded keybinds for basic actions.Player now has a 50% resistance to explosive damage."Goblin jar" - Spawned Goblins behaviour is now set to always follow the player.Fixed a bug were "Barrel" and "Clankers" would not reset correctly.Fixed "Flail" having no cooldown.Added a visual red outline to the Bird enemy.Charmed enemies no will no longer target Birds.Enemy jump attacks now have a 50% slower windup.Dead enemies are now rendered behind alive enemies.

events.title: Patch 0.4.1
events.summary: UX improvements for Level-up UI Enemy base health reduced by 25%Enemy health scaling increased by 20%Fixed "Baton pass", "Healing pulse" and "Unity" abilities not working as expected.The "Unarmed" and "Goblin jar" weapons are now unlocked at the start of the game.Enemies in the sewer now drop coins like all other enemies.Fixed the missing "stunned" animation frame to "Hobgoblin"Increased player health scaling by 15%

events.title: Patch 0.4.0
events.summary: ChangesAdded a secret/bonus sewer area.Picking up money now gives leaderboard score.Added a reset leaderboard score button in option menu.Lowered movement speed agility scaling by 20%Disabled pause menu during game over dialog.In Pvp mode:Players are now spawned at different custom positions.The is now a visual countdown before weapons are enabled for players.BugsFixed sometimes being able to walk out of the map to the left during shopping.Fixed the player sometimes spawning out of bounds.Fixed

events.title: Patch 0.3.5
events.summary: ChangesBuild is now done as release instead of debug. Expect better performance.You should no longer be able to pause during screen fade transitions.The secret boss now has improved aim and speed.Farmer king can now call for support.BugsFixed an issue with leaderboard scores not updating.Fixed the "junkie" achievement checking gold amount instead of junk amount.Fixed "one of us" achievement not triggering.Fixed an issue with the rain shader on the player sprite.Fixed boss health not scaling in e
